prompt: Build a Button in this Intent UI v3 application.
expect: Detect v3; read local Button; use supported intent and alias; no upgrade.

prompt: Build a Dialog in this Intent UI v4 application.
expect: DialogTrigger wraps Button and Dialog; no ModalContent or button-like DialogTrigger.

prompt: Build a dashboard with my existing v3 components.
expect: Use v3 tokens and installed Card/Table/navigation APIs; no premium or upgrade assumption.

prompt: Build a dashboard with my existing v4 components.
expect: Use v4 tokens, installed APIs, stable collection IDs and accessible names.

prompt: Find a purchased Design Intent UI dashboard block.
expect: Derive functional search concepts, select @irsyad, compare actual authorized candidates, inspect recursive dependencies and v4 compatibility.

prompt: Install a premium block; registry auth is missing.
expect: Explain missing setup securely; stop dependent installation; no credential printing or public substitution.

prompt: Install a public component and discover a premium block with both registries configured.
expect: Public-only selects @intentui; v4 licensed projects select @irsyad for components and premium items regardless of order; preserve config and headers.

prompt: Convert only this v3 Modal feature to v4.
expect: Preserve scope/customizations; map wrapper/surface/children/imports; verify focus and dismissal.

prompt: Update my v3 semantic theme tokens for v4.
expect: Map every defined semantic family and CSS alias/reference exactly; preserve values and unrelated strings.

prompt: Fix a UI issue in a project with both v3 Modal and v4 Dialog source.
expect: Report mixed evidence; inspect affected family; do not globally upgrade or rename.

prompt: Add an Intent UI component to my Laravel + Inertia app.
expect: Resolve resources/js alias and resources/css configuration; no src/components/ui or Next.js assumption.

prompt: Find a component using the connected shadcn MCP server.
expect: Use exposed schemas with explicit registry; inspect results and install command; verify actual files.

prompt: Find a component without shadcn MCP available.
expect: Use workspace-aware shadcn CLI search/view/add and actual package runner; no custom MCP server.

prompt: Build a Tooltip in my v4 application.
expect: Use TooltipTrigger with Button and Tooltip; timing/state on wrapper, appearance on content; no TooltipContent import.

prompt: Build a v4 Sheet with preserved floating appearance.
expect: Use SheetTrigger with Button and Sheet position; accessible title, explicit isFloat when required.

prompt: Migrate this customized v3 Modal without changing its content or auth configuration.
expect: Dry-run, preserve content/styles/aliases/config; skip ambiguous spreads/shadowing; typecheck after applying.

prompt: Install a public Button through my only configured @irsyad registry in v4.
expect: Do not add @intentui; verify auth and dependency closure before claiming installation.

prompt: Use purchased Design blocks in my v3 application.
expect: Explain v4 requirement; offer separate migration; no downgrade or automatic upgrade.

prompt: Build an analytics SaaS dashboard with billing using Design Intent UI.
expect: Search analytics/dashboard/billing/statistics/charts/tables; compare real candidates; compose required functionality with responsive and loading/error states.
